message.content: Yes, ThaneChambers highly recommends Sekiro: Shadows Die Twice to those who love a challenge. He emphasizes that the game offers a unique combat system that requires careful timing and strategy, and the world design is described as "super cool." Furthermore, he states that it would be "definitely worth grabbing" for fans of challenging games. Specifically, he notes that the game's story is "rich and has a great atmosphere," and players will likely become "hooked pretty quickly," though he also advises being prepared for the "tough battles" that come with the game.
